newsitem.title: USA: Fresh Choice may not be profitable in '96.
newsitem.headline: Fresh Choice may not be profitable in '96.

text.p: Fresh Choice Inc said Tuesday despite improving its cost structure, it will not be profitable in 1996 unless there is "some substantial change" in sales forecasts.
Earlier, the company said it turned a $329,000, or $0.06 share, profit in the third quarter ended September 8, versus a $228,000 net loss, or $0.04 a share, last year.
In the nine month period, the company reported a net loss of $42,000, or $0.08 a share, versus a loss of $3.1 million, $0.56 a share, last year.
Fresch Choice said same store sales fell 17.0 percent in the third quarter from year ago levels, primarily due to elimination of discount programs.
Sales per restaurant declined 5.9 percent, due to the higher average meal check and the closing of eight under- performing stores over the past 12 months.

In a statement, the company said eliminating its discounting programs and the frequent diner program has hurt sales in the short run. It noted the large number of competitive discount programs in the market and the loss of price-sensitive customers.
